script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be a smart-weighted move of executer.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "jump" on executer.
Let ability3 be the id of the move labelled "evil_jump" on executer.
Let ability4 be the id of the move labelled "sky_grinder" on executer.
If [ability2, ability3, ability4] contains ability, then executer uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "SET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}, {abilityId: ability, abilityOptions: {shouldDeformAllNodes: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{builtin: "UNSET_SA", sa: the INVISIBLE status}]]}}].
Otherwise, executer uses ability.
